semantics.summary: Provides ten special longword variables, not floating-point variables. They are erased by NEW but not by CLEAR, LOAD, CHAIN, or RUN.
side-effects: Values persist across CLEAR, LOAD, CHAIN, and RUN; NEW clears them.

printed-pages: Chapter 13, printed p. 13-35 (same feature: combined update scan p. 14-6)
notes: The range _0 through _9, longword storage, and command-specific clearing behavior are documented in the 3.5 addendum.
The manual gives AllocMem addresses and LibraryBase values as example uses; no host pointer equivalence is implied.
